title: Support of a module on an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$, and let $M$ be a sheaf of modules on its small etale ringed site [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use the point classes and atlas topology of [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Define $\operatorname{Supp}_X(M)$ to be the subset of $|X|$ at which a geometric stalk of $M$ is nonzero. Explicitly, $p$ belongs to it if there are an etale scheme chart $T\to X$, a point $x\in T$ above $p$, and a section $s\in M(T)$ such that for every chart map $f:U\to T$ and every point $y\in U$ above $x$, one has $f^*s\ne0$. This is the nonzero-germ criterion in the filtered colimit defining the geometric stalk; vanishing is independent of the geometric lift.
